brief:
Iran has issued a warning to Israel and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu against pursuing policies that Tehran characterizes as hostile, according to the Quincy Institute. The statement represents the latest verbal escalation between the two regional powers, which maintain a long history of confrontation and mutual accusations.

The Iranian caution does not specify which policies prompted the warning or provide details of potential consequences. The exchange occurs against a backdrop of broader Middle Eastern tensions, with Iran and Israel at odds over nuclear issues, regional influence, and support for armed groups operating across the region. Both governments have previously engaged in cycles of threats and counter-threats.

title: Iran warns Israel and Netanyahu against hostile policies
